Lineage: Bitcoin genesis header <- fork block 25344 (Dr. Time, root 65ef9c66) <- fork block 25351 (PQ-CHAIN, root fc4a1de9) <- this signature over the bad-block header. Novelty is the arrangement; security is SHA-256 preimage resistance only. bad_block.header_source: Reconstructed from the public record (bitcointalk topic 822) and hash-verified against the known bad-block hash.

verify: Reconstruct the bad-block header from the fields above (or take bad_block.header_hex), then call trifold_lockbox.verify(bytes.fromhex(trifold_root), header_bytes, signature) with hex fields decoded; it returns True. Any 1-bit change to the header makes it return False.
